entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Seeing this reminds me of the days[n]you still acted like a prince.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Things have gotten pretty dark since[n]then...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Complain all you like, but this is who I[n]am. I'm not going to change back.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm not complaining. It's better to[n]know you're being honest and not[n]hiding anything from us.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Honest, huh.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh yeah... Robin Hood.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: When I first saw him, I thought he was[n]just as lame as Akechi.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But now that I know a lil more about[n]him, it kinda makes me think.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I know what you mean.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He probably wouldn't be too happy if[n]he heard us talking like this, though.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: This Persona is yours, Akechi-senpai?[n]I'm surprised. It's very, um... noble.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Ah, that's right. I suppose you've never[n]seen this one.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Never! Do you fight with it the same[n]way?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: You know, "Muahahahaaa! You're all[n]gonna die! Sayonara, suckers!"

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Heh. Are you mocking me?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It ain't fair that he gets to have two[n]Personas.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Aren't you kinda jealous?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sometimes. Is it something you can[n]train yourself to do?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Personas are part of your personality,[n]correct? Why don't you try acting like[n]someone you're not?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit, Akechi!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Down, boy. Learn to take a jo—

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You're a frickin' genius! Let's do it!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Good idea! I wonder what I should act[n]like...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Hah. And here I thought I'd seen the[n]limits of your idiocy.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, I can't believe Akechi faked his[n]personality so well, even if I hated it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Totally. I've gotta admit, he has some[n]impressive acting talent.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If only that went for someone else we[n]know...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What was that? I couldn't hear you.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Robin Hood exemplifies the philosophy[n]of living in the name of justice.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: To think this was a part of Akechi as[n]well...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He was kinda two-faced, right? It doesn't[n]really make sense to me...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I mean, I'm me. There's only one Ann[n]Takamaki. I think I'd get confused fast[n]if there were more.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Agreed. If there were another side of me[n]that disavowed the pursuit of beauty in[n]art, there would be a bitter duel.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And the winner would be...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Me. The one who does pursue beauty.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, I think we all knew the answer to[n]that.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: For better or worse, I think we're a[n]little too honest with ourselves to have[n]two Personas.
